name: fmarslan.com Jekyll
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'bundle config set --local path /home/dev/.bundle/vendor && bundle install && mkdir -p /home/dev/.codex/skills && if [ ! -e /home/dev/.codex/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills ]; then git clone https://github.com/fmarslan/ai-skills /home/dev/.codex/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills; elif [ -d /home/dev/.codex/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills/.git ]; then git -C /home/dev/.codex/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills pull --ff-only; else echo "Skill path exists but is not a Git checkout; leaving it unchanged."; fi && test -w /home/dev/.codex || (echo "ERROR: /home/dev/.codex is not writable. Recreate the codex-home Docker volume." && exit 1)'
